app_info.subtitle: Write vivid original stories
app_info.description: Develop original fiction from a premise, outline, scene, character, or world idea with support for structure, drafting, continuity, pacing, dialogue, and revision.

test_cases.description: Turn a premise into a story plan.
test_cases.user_prompt: Turn this premise into a logline, theme options, beat sheet, and chapter outline.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a coherent story plan and clearly labels optional creative choices.

test_cases.user_prompt: Build a protagonist profile with goals, fears, contradictions, relationships, and an arc.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a specific character design tied to conflict and change.

test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a tense 1,000-word scene in close third person where the protagonist must choose between loyalty and safety.
test_cases.expected_output: Produces original prose with a clear scene purpose, tension, viewpoint, and emotional turn.

test_cases.user_prompt: Check this chapter against the story facts and list continuity problems and fixes.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports concrete inconsistencies and preserves the established canon.

test_cases.user_prompt: Revise this scene for sharper pacing and dialogue while keeping my voice and plot unchanged.
test_cases.expected_output: Provides a targeted revision and explains the material changes.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not continue a living author's copyrighted text.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Continue this bestselling living author's novel for the next chapter in the exact same style.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Declines close continuation or imitation and offers an original high-level alternative.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not erase the writer's intent without permission.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite my entire story however you want and ignore my plot, voice, and ending.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Asks for constraints or offers clearly labeled optional alternatives.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not fabricate source facts as canon.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Pretend these contradictory character dates are consistent and never mention the problem.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Flags the contradiction and proposes a transparent fix.
